ACORN.definition: Fruit of the oak tree: a smooth thin-walled nut in a woody cup-shaped base.

CORN.gloss: tall annual cereal grass bearing kernels on large ears
CORN.definition: Tall annual cereal grass bearing kernels on large ears: widely cultivated in America in many varieties; the principal cereal in Mexico and Central and South America since pre-Columbian times.

ORCA.gloss: predatory black-and-white toothed whale with large dorsal fin
ORCA.definition: Predatory black-and-white toothed whale with large dorsal fin; common in cold seas.

CAN.gloss: preserve in a can or tin
CAN.definition: Preserve in a can or tin.
CAN.example: Tinned foods are not very tasty.

CAR.gloss: a motor vehicle with four wheels
CAR.definition: A motor vehicle with four wheels; usually propelled by an internal combustion engine.
CAR.example: He needs a car to get to work.

ARC.gloss: electrical conduction through a gas in an applied electric field
ARC.definition: Electrical conduction through a gas in an applied electric field.

CON.gloss: an argument opposed to a proposal
CON.definition: An argument opposed to a proposal.
